meta.name: west4-money-cases
meta.what: Test vectors for the one pricing module (docs/spec/05-money-rules.md). Each case names the function under test, its inputs and its expected outputs, all in integer cents. Every expected value was computed by a script with exact fractions and re-checked by a second, separately written script that uses integer arithmetic only.
meta.companion: seed/west4-friday.json holds the Friday these cases come from; docs/demo-seed.md tells its story.
meta.units: Integer cents. Times are ISO 8601. The venue is America/New_York with a 06:00 day cutover.

rounding.rule: Half up to the cent, on exact values (no floats). Where the spec says it: docs/spec/05-money-rules.md rule 1 (Cents and rounding), rule 3 (room time is rounded once), rule 8 (tax once per rate per revision).
rounding.divided_amounts: Largest remainder: floors first, then leftover cents go to the largest fractional remainders, ties to the first parts. For an even split of n shares the first (amount mod n) shares get one extra cent.
rounding.negative_amounts: Never rounded. A comp, void or reversal is the exact negative of a stored line, and tax is worked on the net (post-comp) positive base.
rounding.tax_by_category: The check's tax is rounded once, then shared across categories by largest remainder of each category's exact tax (rate x base). The spec says 'shared across categories by largest remainder' without naming the basis; this is the reading used.

functions.check_totals: lines[{kind, tax_category, cents}], deposit_cents, gratuity_applies -> subtotal, tax (once, shared by category), gratuity, total, left_to_pay
functions.check_revision: rev1_lines, added_lines, deposit_cents -> the reversal and new computed lines of revision 2
functions.room_time_between: start, end (ISO with offset), hourly_cents -> elapsed_minutes (real elapsed time) and room_time_cents
functions.room_tab_at: party_size, is_vip_room, business_date, minutes, drink_lines, deposit_cents -> room time, drinks, tab so far, and what presenting the check now would total
functions.hourly_rate_at: local_time, party_size, is_vip_room -> business_date, minimum guests, billable guests, hourly_cents
functions.business_date: local_time -> business_date (local time minus the 06:00 cutover) and minutes_from_midnight at the start of that date
functions.deposit: party_size, business_date -> first-hour deposit (billable x $10.00), or the flat $250.00 from 20 guests
functions.deposit_vs_check: deposit_cents, check_total_cents -> deposit applied, left to pay, forfeit line
functions.split_even: amount_cents, shares -> share amounts, first shares get the extra cents
functions.pay_my_share_even: amount_left_cents, tax, gratuity, guests, guest_name, share_no -> the guest's share, their share of tax and gratuity, and the log line
functions.card_fee: amount_cents, rate_pct, funding -> surcharge, tax on it if taxable, what the card pays
functions.z_report_gratuity: room_checks[{room_time, drinks, comps}], bar_tabs[{drinks}] -> the Z gratuity (sum of room-check gratuity lines) and the drink split
functions.approval_route: requester, manager_on_duty, owner -> who the request goes to
functions.refund_cap: captured_cents, earlier_refunds_cents, requested_cents -> the most that payment can still refund
functions.tip_review: tab_total_cents, tip_cents, entered_after_minutes, limits -> needs_approval and why
functions.tip_pool: pool_cents, minutes by person -> shares by largest remainder
functions.tip_choices: drinks_before_tax_cents -> the three choices the reader shows (in expected only)
functions.can_present_check: orders -> whether Present the check is allowed
functions.package_line_shares: a package's price and its units' regular prices -> each line's share, by largest remainder (K-09; test prices)

properties: Split shares and tip shares always add up to the amount, and no two differ by more than 1 cent.
In an even split, the first (amount mod n) shares are the larger ones.
Room time is rounded once over all segments, never per segment.
Tax is rounded once per rate per revision; the by-category shares add up to it.
total = subtotal + tax + gratuity; left to pay = total - deposit allocated, never below zero.
Gratuity is never applied to a bar tab or a damage fee, and is computed before tax.
The Z report's gratuity is the sum of room-check gratuity lines, never a percent of all sales.

ambiguities.topic: Z report gratuity: sum of lines or 20% of the total
ambiguities.spec_says: docs/spec/05-money-rules.md rules 9 and 16: the sum of the gratuity lines on the checks that carry one, never a percent of all sales.
ambiguities.gap: Fix brief 4.18 words it as '20% of (room time + room drinks + packages sold to rooms - room comps and refunds)', which reads as an aggregate. The two can differ by a cent or more (Rooms 3 and 12: 9626 vs 9627).
ambiguities.used_here: The spec: sum of lines. Cases z_gratuity_sum_of_lines_vs_aggregate and z_gratuity_room_checks_only.

ambiguities.topic: Returned orders and the reason-only limit
ambiguities.spec_says: A returned order is resolved as void - not made, void - made (waste) or remake (rule 6). Comps and voids over $25 each or $75 a shift need approval (rule 7).
ambiguities.gap: Not said whether a void that resolves a return counts as a comp or void under the limit. o4's $36.00 would be over $25.00.
ambiguities.used_here: No vector. The scenario in seed/west4-friday.json flags it.

ambiguities.spec_says: docs/spec/06-stripe-setup.md and 07-payment-flows.md: fixed $1, $2, $3 on anything under $10, otherwise 18, 20 and 22% of the drinks before tax.
ambiguities.gap: Whether a tab of exactly $10.00 gets fixed amounts or percentages depends on Stripe's smart_tip_threshold.
ambiguities.used_here: No vector at $10.00; the vectors use $9.00 and $12.00 and up.

ambiguities.spec_says: A tip over 25% or $50, or entered more than 2 hours late, needs approval (docs/spec/07-payment-flows.md).
ambiguities.gap: The base for 25% is not named: the tab total or the drinks before tax (the base the choices use).
ambiguities.used_here: Tab total, and no vector sits near the boundary.

ambiguities.topic: Tax on the card surcharge, kept deposits and no-show charges
ambiguities.spec_says: Rule 8: the accountant confirms. docs/spec/14-open-questions.md lists it as open.
ambiguities.gap: Whether a surcharge or a forfeit line is taxable.
ambiguities.used_here: The surcharge case shows tax_on_surcharge_if_taxable_cents and card_pays_with_tax_on_fee_cents as if-taxable; the forfeit case computes no tax on the forfeit line.

ambiguities.topic: Deposit against the check: total or subtotal
ambiguities.spec_says: Rule 11: if the check closes for less than the deposit, the rest becomes a forfeit line.
ambiguities.gap: Whether 'less than the deposit' compares the deposit with the check total (with tax and gratuity) or with the subtotal.
ambiguities.used_here: The total, which matches how amount due is worked (lines minus allocations).

ambiguities.topic: Minutes from midnight on the two daylight-saving nights
ambiguities.spec_says: Rule 2: durations come from elapsed time; times in settings are wall-clock times resolved per date by Temporal.
ambiguities.gap: Whether 'minutes from midnight at the start of that date' on Nov 1, 2026 and Mar 14, 2027 counts wall-clock minutes or elapsed minutes. Bands read it.
ambiguities.used_here: Wall-clock reading in the business_date cases; elapsed time everywhere a duration is billed.

ambiguities.spec_says: Rule 14: a refund writes reversing lines for its share of tax, gratuity and card fee.
ambiguities.gap: How a partial refund's share is rounded when it isn't a whole check.

ambiguities.spec_says: Rule 8: shared across categories by largest remainder.
ambiguities.gap: The basis is not spelled out.
ambiguities.used_here: Each category's exact tax (rate x base), leftover cents to the largest remainders. Room 9: 2858 room time + 1402 drinks.

ambiguities.spec_says: Rule 1 says tip shares use largest remainder. The default pool by hours is an open lawyer question (docs/spec/14-open-questions.md).
ambiguities.used_here: One vector shows the rounding only.

ambiguities.topic: Canvas disagrees with the spec on split leftovers
ambiguities.spec_says: Rules 1 and 13: leftover cents go to the first shares.
ambiguities.gap: Rail.dc.html floors each share and gives the remainder to the last share (the canvas is frozen at v39).
